name: Goat Water
desc: Montserrat's national dish: a thick, spicy goat stew with cloves, thyme and hot pepper, served with a bread roll. More broth than stew. Restores 200 HP.

name: Soursop Juice
desc: Cold, creamy juice from the soursop, a spiny green fruit that tastes of strawberry, pineapple and a nap. Restores 130 HP.

name: Bush Tea
desc: A cup of herbal tea brewed from leaves picked on the hill, believed to cure anything from a cold to a bad mood. Restores 110 HP.

name: Jar of Ash
desc: A jar of fine grey ash from the Exclusion Zone boundary, soft as flour, with tiny glassy specks that catch the light. It is still very slightly warm.

name: Piece of Pumice
desc: A light, pale rock full of bubbles, thrown out by the volcano. It floats in water. Tough, young and not done yet.
msg: {name}'s Pumice took the heat out of it!
